title: AncyMonPairingPayload
description: Compact pairing payload encoded inside the terminal QR code for zero-typing onboarding of the Flutter mobile client.

ip.description: IPv4/IPv6 address or resolvable hostname of the central server on the local area network.

port.description: TLS ingress port terminated by Caddy reverse proxy.

token.description: Pre-shared key (PSK) bearer authentication secret token.

ca.description: Raw Base64-encoded DER representation of Caddy's internal ECDSA P-256 root CA certificate (without PEM headers or line breaks).
